mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an easing monetary policy, which may lead to increased borrowing and investment, thus driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with low FEDFUNDS levels over a 20-day horizon in easing cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth, indicated by GDPC1 growth below 2%, may signal economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive when GDPC1 growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE) combined with high payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which may boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when UNRATE is low and PAYEMS is high.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth (INDPRO) during an economic expansion signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative during expansion with INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in federal funds rate above 5% may indicate monetary tightening, leading to increased borrowing costs and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with increased housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when GDPC1 and HOUST are both strong.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates (UNRATE) signal a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when UNRATE is low.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production growth (INDPRO) below 1% may indicate supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive when INDPRO growth is below 1%.
